verdict.rationale: Riskified is an API-driven SaaS, so scoped API credentials are a fair question, but the evidence shows only a single merchant authentication token used to compute HMAC request signatures. Nothing shows scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent credentials. SAML SSO covers human account access and is an adjacent control, not scoped API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
